name: Eugene
seo_title: Eugene Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 23 Events, 5 Free
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Eugene for 2026, and here is what he found: 23 family events across Eugene, Junction City, Veneta and Pleasant Hill, 5 of them free. The magic runs from November 20 (Photos with Santa at Valley River Center) through December 29, with the Festival of Trees (November 27 to 29), the Oakway Center Christmas Tree Lighting (November 29), the Junction City Holiday Light Parade (December 4) and Eugene Ballet: The Nutcracker (December 19 to 24) and the Oregon Ballet Academy Nutcracker (December 19 and 20) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Eugene

  • 23 Christmas events for kids in Eugene, including the Junction City and Veneta light parades and a Pleasant Hill tree farm
  • 5 free events, including the Oakway Center Christmas Tree Lighting, Photos with Santa and Snow Shows at 5th Street Public Market, the Junction City Holiday Light Parade, the Veneta Tree Lighting and Christmas Light Parade, and Family Musical Adventures at the Hult Center
  • Meet Santa: Photos with Santa at 5th Street Public Market (November 27 to December 20), Photos with Santa at Valley River Center, Sensory Santa (December 6) and Breakfast with Santa (December 12)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Oakway Center Christmas Tree Lighting (November 29), the Veneta Tree Lighting (December 3), Holiday Night Out and the Kesey Square Tree Lighting (December 4), the Junction City Holiday Light Parade (December 4) and the Veneta Christmas Light Parade (December 10)
  • Trains: no train ride runs in Eugene itself; for a longer ride see Santiam Excursion Trains in Lebanon
  • Season: November 20 to December 29
